questions.question:
Seven friends P, Q, R, S, T, U and V sit in a row facing north. The following facts are known:
1. P sits at one of the two extreme ends.
2. T sits immediately to the left of P.
3. V sits exactly in the middle.
4. Q sits immediately to the left of V.
5. R sits immediately to the right of V.
6. U sits immediately to the left of Q.

Who sits at the left end?
questions.explanation: From left to right the seating is S, U, Q, V, R, T, P, so S sits at the left end.
